# `/access-request-status` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /access-request-status/v1

`listAccessRequestStatusV1` — Access request status

Use this API to return a list of access request statuses based on the specified query parameters. If an access request was made for access that an identity already has, the API ignores the access request. These ignored requests do not display in the list of access request statuses. Any user with any user level can get the status of their own access requests. A user with ORG_ADMIN is required to call this API to get a list of statuses for other users. For access requests for machines, each…

- Scopes: idn:access-request-status:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `requested-for` (query) — Filter the results by the identity the requests were made for. *me* indicates the current user. Mutually exclusive with *regarding-identity*.
  - `requested-by` (query) — Filter the results by the identity who made the requests. *me* indicates the current user. Mutually exclusive with *regarding-identity*.
  - `regarding-identity` (query) — Filter the results by the specified identity who is either the requester or target of the requests. *me* indicates the current user. Mutually exclusive with *requested-for* and *requested-by*.
  - `assigned-to` (query) — Filter the results by the specified identity who is the owner of the Identity Request Work Item. *me* indicates the current user.
  - `count` (query) — default False — If this is true, the *X-Total-Count* response header populates with the number of results that would be returned if limit and offset were ignored.
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return.
  - `offset` (query) — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. Defaults to 0 if not specified.
  - `filters` (query) — fields: accessRequestId: eq, ge, gt, le, lt, ne, sw; accountActivityItemId: eq, in, ge, gt, le, ne, sw; created: eq, ge, gt, le, lt, ne — e.g. `accountActivityItemId eq "2c918086771c86df0177401efcdf54c0"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: created, modified, accountActivityItemId, name — e.g. `created`
  - `request-state` (query) — Filter the results by the state of the request. The only valid value is *EXECUTING*.
- Returns 200: array of requesteditemstatus
